confirm_payment_intent.description: Complete a payment by confirming it with a payment method.
confirm_payment_intent.name: confirm_payment_intent

parameters.description: The ID of the Stripe payment to confirm.
parameters.name: payment_intent_id

parameters.description: The ID of the payment method to charge, for example pm_card_visa in test mode.
parameters.name: payment_method

returns.description: Stripe payment intent object with status updated to 'succeeded'.

create_customer.description: Create a new Stripe customer with contact details.
create_customer.name: create_customer

parameters.description: Customer email
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Customer name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Customer description
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Customer phone number
parameters.name: phone

returns.description: Stripe customer object returned by the Stripe API containing customer details.

create_payment_intent.description: Set up a payment to charge a customer a custom amount.
create_payment_intent.name: create_payment_intent

parameters.description: The amount to charge, in the smallest currency unit, for example cents for USD (500 means $5.00).
parameters.name: amount

parameters.description: The three-letter currency code, for example usd.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The ID of a customer to link this payment to (optional).
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: A short note describing what the payment is for.
parameters.name: description

create_payment_link.description: Generate a payment link for a price.
create_payment_link.name: create_payment_link

parameters.description: Stripe price ID
parameters.name: price_id

parameters.description: Quantity to purchase
parameters.name: quantity

returns.description: Stripe payment link object returned by the Stripe API containing the generated link URL.

create_price.description: Create a one-time or recurring price for a product.
create_price.name: create_price

parameters.description: Stripe product ID
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: The price in the smallest currency unit, for example cents for USD (500 means $5.00).
parameters.name: unit_amount

parameters.description: The three-letter currency code, for example usd.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: How often the customer is billed: day, week, month, or year.
parameters.name: interval

create_product.description: Create a product to sell with Stripe.
create_product.name: create_product

parameters.description: Product name
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Product description
parameters.name: description

returns.description: Stripe product object returned by the Stripe API containing product details.

list_customers.description: List your most recent Stripe customers.
list_customers.name: list_customers

parameters.description: Maximum customers to return

returns.description: Array of Stripe customer objects returned by the Stripe API.

items.description: Stripe customer object with customer details from the Stripe API.

refund_payment.description: Refund a payment, in full or in part.
refund_payment.name: refund_payment

parameters.description: The ID of the Stripe payment to refund.
parameters.name: payment_intent_id

parameters.description: The amount to refund, in the smallest currency unit, for example cents for USD (200 means $2.00). Leave blank to refund the full payment.
parameters.name: amount

returns.description: Stripe refund object returned by the Stripe API containing refund details.

retrieve_customer.description: Look up a Stripe customer by their ID. Fails the step when the ID is empty, as it is for a guest checkout (a payment with no customer), so look up only payments that have a customer.
retrieve_customer.name: retrieve_customer

parameters.description: Stripe customer ID
parameters.name: customer_id

returns.description: Stripe customer object returned by the Stripe API for the requested customer ID.

description: Accept payments and automate billing workflows with Stripe.

stripe_checkout_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a customer completes a Stripe Checkout page or Payment Link. Check payment_status: it is unpaid while a delayed method such as a bank debit is still clearing.

output.amount_total: The total, in the currency's smallest unit (cents).
output.amount_total_display: The total as a person writes it, such as $12.50.
output.created: When the checkout started, as a Unix timestamp.
output.currency: The three-letter currency code, such as usd.
output.customer: The customer's id, empty for a guest checkout.
output.customer_details: The buyer's email, name, phone and address as entered.
output.event_created: When the event happened, as a Unix timestamp.
output.event_id: The id of the Stripe event (evt_...).
output.metadata: Your own key-value data saved on the session.
output.payment_intent: The payment's id, for a one-off payment.
output.payment_link: The Payment Link's id, when the checkout came from one.
output.payment_status: paid, unpaid (a delayed payment method) or no_payment_required.
output.subscription: The subscription's id, when the checkout started one.

stripe_invoice_paid_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice is paid in Stripe, including each renewal of a subscription and an invoice marked paid outside Stripe. Amounts are in the currency's smallest unit, so 5000 is $50.

output.amount_due: The amount due, in the currency's smallest unit (cents).
output.amount_due_display: The amount due as a person writes it, such as $12.50.
output.amount_paid: The amount paid, in the currency's smallest unit (cents).
output.amount_paid_display: The amount paid as a person writes it, such as $12.50.
output.amount_remaining: What is still owed, in the currency's smallest unit.
output.amount_remaining_display: What is still owed as a person writes it, such as $12.50.
output.attempt_count: How many times Stripe has tried to collect payment.
output.created: When the invoice was created, as a Unix timestamp.
output.currency: The three-letter currency code, such as usd.
output.event_created: When the event happened, as a Unix timestamp.
output.event_id: The id of the Stripe event (evt_...).
output.hosted_invoice_url: The invoice's page, where the customer can pay it.
output.invoice_pdf: A link to download the invoice as a PDF.
output.next_payment_attempt: When Stripe tries again, as a Unix timestamp, if it will.
output.status: The status, such as paid or open.

stripe_invoice_payment_failed_trigger.description: Runs each time Stripe fails to collect an invoice, such as a declined card on a subscription renewal. attempt_count says which try it was, and next_payment_attempt when Stripe tries again.

output.amount_due: The amount due, in the currency's smallest unit (cents).
output.amount_due_display: The amount due as a person writes it, such as $12.50.
output.amount_paid: The amount paid, in the currency's smallest unit (cents).
output.amount_paid_display: The amount paid as a person writes it, such as $12.50.
output.amount_remaining: What is still owed, in the currency's smallest unit.
output.amount_remaining_display: What is still owed as a person writes it, such as $12.50.
output.attempt_count: How many times Stripe has tried to collect payment.
output.created: When the invoice was created, as a Unix timestamp.
output.currency: The three-letter currency code, such as usd.
output.event_created: When the event happened, as a Unix timestamp.
output.event_id: The id of the Stripe event (evt_...).
output.hosted_invoice_url: The invoice's page, where the customer can pay it.
output.invoice_pdf: A link to download the invoice as a PDF.
output.next_payment_attempt: When Stripe tries again, as a Unix timestamp, if it will.
output.status: The status, such as paid or open.

stripe_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is created in Stripe, by a checkout, an invoice, the dashboard or the API.

output.created: When the customer was created, as a Unix timestamp.
output.description: The description saved on the customer.
output.event_created: When the event happened, as a Unix timestamp.
output.event_id: The id of the Stripe event (evt_...).
output.metadata: Your own key-value data saved on the customer.
output.name: Their name.

stripe_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs when a new payment is created in Stripe or, with a status set, when a payment reaches that status. The event gives the amount (in cents, so 5000 is $50), currency and status, and who paid as customer_name and customer_email, which are blank when Stripe doesn't know them (a guest checkout may have neither).

parameters.description: Only run for payments in this Stripe status, such as succeeded. Leave empty to run for every payment, including ones still waiting for the customer to pay.
parameters.name: status

stripe_new_subscription_trigger.description: Runs when a subscription is started in Stripe, including one that starts with a free trial.

output.cancel_at_period_end: Whether it is set to end when the period it is in ends.
output.canceled_at: When it was canceled, as a Unix timestamp, if it was.
output.cancellation_details: Why it was canceled, and any feedback the customer gave.
output.created: When the subscription was created, as a Unix timestamp.
output.customer: The customer's id; use 'Retrieve a Stripe customer' for the rest.
output.ended_at: When it ended, as a Unix timestamp, if it has.
output.event_created: When the event happened, as a Unix timestamp.
output.event_id: The id of the Stripe event (evt_...).
output.items: What is subscribed to: each item's price, product and quantity.
output.metadata: Your own key-value data saved on the subscription.
output.status: The status, such as active, trialing or canceled.

stripe_subscription_ended_trigger.description: Runs when a subscription ends in Stripe: canceled straight away, at the end of its period, or after payment kept failing. One set to cancel later runs this when it actually ends.

output.cancel_at_period_end: Whether it is set to end when the period it is in ends.
output.canceled_at: When it was canceled, as a Unix timestamp, if it was.
output.cancellation_details: Why it was canceled, and any feedback the customer gave.
output.created: When the subscription was created, as a Unix timestamp.
output.customer: The customer's id; use 'Retrieve a Stripe customer' for the rest.
output.ended_at: When it ended, as a Unix timestamp, if it has.
output.event_created: When the event happened, as a Unix timestamp.
output.event_id: The id of the Stripe event (evt_...).
output.items: What is subscribed to: each item's price, product and quantity.
output.metadata: Your own key-value data saved on the subscription.
output.status: The status, such as active, trialing or canceled.
